_comment: Explicit, user-supplied values for endpoint body fields this tool cannot safely determine on its own (e.g. a specific episode/thread identifier a sub-page needs). Never auto-filled or guessed -- add an entry keyed by the EXACT URL you're testing, only after you've confirmed the value yourself. Example: "https://ramaniv.com/liftoff/episode-00-why-pm": {"episodeSlug": "episode-00-why-pm", "episodeTitle": "Why Do You Want to Become a PM?"}
